text: The Government of Tamil Nadu and the UK Government launched a Heat Resilience Centre for the state, with a Letter of Intent signed in November 2025.

text: It is to coordinate heat-risk management across sectors and support city and district heat action planning.

In April 2026 Maharashtra launched a Centre of Excellence on extreme heat and sustainable cooling, operating first from IIM Nagpur and later to become part of the planned State Institute of Disaster Management.
